properties.description: Every presented data byte must match the accepted input prefix or a justified zero-padding byte; unsolicited data is an alarm, independently of ready.
Every presented data beat has the expected final-byte marker for the clamped 4..8-byte output frame.
Presented status responses match completed accepted input frames in order, including both lengths and padding/truncation flags, independently of data completion.
Data and status remain stable while blocked; synchronous reset clears presented valids and cancels queued obligations without clearing historical alarms.

Checks meaningful observations for unknowns, source reset/blocked-offer protocol, the 1..12-byte input bound, and bounded scoreboard exhaustion. These alarms do not classify invalid inputs as DUT failures.

Combinational final-post completion check: no incomplete input, queued response, or remaining valid; reset is low, both sinks are ready, and at least 32 uninterrupted idle drain edges have occurred. This common minimum does not certify the separately required 128-cycle final-tail qualification.
